bloom-bloom:lever:8c142102-49a6-4312-892.title: Workplace Evolutionist (Facilitator)
bloom-bloom:lever:8c142102-49a6-4312-892.description: I’m Avery, Founder & CEO of Bloom, a leadership development and fractional HR partner helping organizations build high-performing, human-centred teams. About Bloom We work with companies that want more than surface-level change. Through training, advisory, and ongoing HR support, we help leaders make better decisions, strengthen team culture, and create workplaces where people can perform, contribute, and grow with dignity and respect. Our work is grounded in the Bloom Framework, a practical model for modern leadership that helps organizations build awareness, lead with responsibility, operationalize fairness, own their impact, and mobilize people. We’ve partnered with more than 200 companies across 50+ countries, including Shopify, Spotify, Knix, SmartSweets, CMHA, and CanadaHelps, helping them rethink leadership, employee experience, and the systems that shape how work works and how people experience it. Our Approach The system of work was not built with most of the workforce in mind. At Bloom, we believe meaningful change has to move across the full workplace ecosystem. That means looking at the structures that shape work, from policies and systems to everyday practices, while also building the individual and collective capacity needed to sustain change over time. Our approach goes beyond structure alone. We help organizations strengthen awareness, deepen understanding, and build the behaviours, ownership, and accountability required to lead and work differently. For us, better workplaces are built when policy is paired with practice, and when people are equipped not just to understand change, but to carry it forward together. This is how we move toward workplaces that are more thoughtful, more effective, and more human. The Opportunity Right now, we’re hiring Change Strategist, Evolutionist, and DEI Facilitators to join our collective of educators. This role is about more than delivering workshops. It’s about helping leaders and teams build the awareness, skills, and behaviours needed to work better together. We’re looking for facilitators who can translate complex workplace dynamics into practical, actionable learning that supports real organizational change. If you’re passionate about leadership, workplace culture, and anti-oppressive practice, we’d love to connect.

Job Title: Senior COHE / LOTO Engineer Location: Limerick Contract Type: Staff or Contract Job Summary We are seeking an experienced COHE / LOTO Coordinator to support a large-scale biopharma commissioning project. This role will be responsible for the development, implementation, and management of Control of Hazardous Energy (COHE) and Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) systems across a complex, multi-system facility during commissioning and start-up activities. The project involves the safe energisation and commissioning of upstream and downstream bioprocessing systems, including bioreactors, CIP/SIP systems, chromatography, filtration, and associated utilities. This includes ensuring all hazardous energy sources are accurately identified, controlled, and managed throughout construction, commissioning, and qualification phases to support safe and compliant system start-up. This is a highly safety-critical, site-based role requiring strong technical expertise, excellent coordination skills, and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, multi-contractor commissioning environment. It is ideally suited to experienced professionals with a proven track record in implementing COHE/LOTO programmes within regulated biopharma or pharmaceutical facilities.
